note: Re-quoted to the Open Word Bible, Balanced edition (owb-ja, CC0), per the founder decision that Japanese quotes OWB for every work (2026-11-19); it replaces the 口語訳 (japkougo) wording the translation first shipped with. Inside a quotation OWB's own words stand (洗礼, 霊, ペトロ, 五旬祭) while the translator's prose keeps バプテスマ, 御霊 and the library's citation forms.

A `mined` row is a quotation (cited, uncited, or a verbatim recitation without marks) whose words are exact OWB, checked against the bundled text: a span of the verse, or pieces of it joined with '……' (the inner 「」 of a nested quotation written 『』). block_index counts per chapter (chapter_order).

A `self_rendered` row is an allusion or Torrey's own paraphrase (Eph 3:16-19, Ps 139:23-24, John 3:16, 1 Sam 11:6, Mark 5:30, John 10:28-30, 1 Cor 12:31, the phrase 'spoke with tongues'), which stays the translator's wording, plus one place OWB cannot serve: Matt 17:21 'this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting' (5.17), which OWB omits with the critical text (its Mark 9:29 has prayer only), while Torrey argues from the fasting.
